decisions.reason: It fits the firm’s hearing-care core business, but the weaker website presence suggests a somewhat higher risk that it could be rationalized if demand stays limited or overlaps with adjacent earmold products.

As a clearly presented custom earmold product for in-ear hearing systems, it matches the firm’s established portfolio and integrated-solution strategy, so management would usually continue it beyond the first year.

A vacuum thermoforming unit supports the firm’s established lab and production workflows and, as a dedicated equipment offering in a growing market, is likely to be retained unless early sales are clearly disappointing.
